novelty_basis: Not stated in Le Floch's notes (which say 'containing' for 501, 883, 1083, 'unknown' for 677, 'not 6 nor 7' for 1076). Sizes 2 and 3 are surely known to the ETP (it determined size-2 and size-3 model existence for all order-4 laws), and small sizes may be in its finite-magma searches; only the gaps at n >= 5 (501: 6,7; 677: 6; 883: 6; 1076: 8; 1083: 5,6) are plausible additions.
proof_check: computer-assisted - DRUP refutations from Glucose 4 verified by drat-trim (48/48 instances of EXP-C05-06); trust base = drat-trim, the CNF generator (Lemma 0, brute-force cross-checked) and the soundness of the added constraints (Lemma 4 / Lean left_mul_bijective_of_law)
statement:
No magma of the stated order satisfies: 501 x = y(y(x(xy))) - orders 2, 3, 6, 7; 677 x = y(x((yx)y)) - orders
2, 3, 4, 6; 883 x = y((xy)(yy)) - orders 3, 6; 1076 x = y((x(xy))y) - order 8; 1083 x = y((x(yx))y) -
orders 2, 5, 6; 1719 x = (yy)((xx)y) - order 2.
title: New spectrum gaps for open ETP laws (certified UNSAT): 501 has no models of orders 6, 7; 677 none of order 6; 883 none of 6; 1076 none of 8; 1083 none of 5, 6
